description: Canonical Nexus model router policy table (SPEC-009 required test: router policy table; EP-015 M2). The policy engine is the deterministic authority for route selection; learned scorers and the Microbrain are advisory only. The failover section (EP-015 M5; ADR-022; LF-021) bounds provider failover: max provider attempts, per-attempt cost budget consumed, and per-attempt latency budget consumed.
